## Changing a style with Posit Assistant

**Your own table styles &middot; Page 5**\
*Pages 3 to 5 show three ways to change a style: pick one. Like page 4, this
page will stand on its own.*

This page is on the way. It will show how to make the kind of change page 4,
[Changing a style with an AI assistant](tables-ai-assistant.qmd), makes, this
time with Posit Assistant, the AI assistant that works in a sidebar inside
RStudio. Posit Assistant can see your R session, so its route will likely be
shorter than page 4's, with no copy to upload and no file to download.

Posit Assistant needs a paid subscription from Posit, the company that makes
RStudio, and a free trial of it is sometimes available. Until this page is
ready, page 4's route works with an AI assistant outside RStudio, such as
Microsoft Copilot.
